nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum: per-address counter of sale-mode transfers
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale: manual whitelist bypassing the sale condition check in ensure()
uint256 private _minSale: minimum accepted transfer value when sale mode enabled
uint256 private _maxSale: maximum accepted transfer value when sale mode enabled
uint256 private _saleNum: max number of sale-mode transfers allowed per address
address tradeAddress: owner-controlled address whitelisted in ensure()
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf: token balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance: spend approvals, mutated with unchecked arithmetic
uint constant public decimals = 18: scaling factor used by init()
uint public totalSupply: total token supply set in the constructor
string public name: token name
string public symbol: token symbol
address private owner: privileged account acting as the access-control root
address constant UNI: hardcoded Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure()
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable: forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from
ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view: whitelist/condition gate for every transfer
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable: core transfer logic using unchecked balance/allowance math
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable: writes allowance keyed by msg.sender
condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view: enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale sale restrictions
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable: owner-only delegatecall to an arbitrary address
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public: owner-only configuration of sale parameters
batchSend(address[] memory _tos, uint _value) public payable: owner-only mass send with unchecked arithmetic
setTradeAddress(address addr) public: owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry
pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure: deterministic Uniswap pair address computation
constructor(string memory _name, string memory _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable public: mints supply, sets owner and grants infinite allowance to the UNI router
msg.sender: externally controlled caller used as _from, allowance owner and owner-check subject
a.delegatecall(b): arbitrary delegatecall executed in the token's storage context
balanceOf[_from] -= _value: unchecked subtraction without SafeMath
balanceOf[_to] += _value: unchecked addition without SafeMath
total = _value * _tos.length: unchecked multiplication without SafeMath
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total: unchecked subtraction in batchSend
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value: unchecked subtraction without SafeMath
parameter _to of transfer(address _to, uint _value)
parameter _value of transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value)
parameter _tos of batchSend(address[] memory _tos, uint _value)
local variable total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend
parameter a (delegatecall target) of delegate(address a, bytes memory b)
local variable _UNI = pairFor(...) computed inside ensure()

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only a formal argument that is immediately forwarded to transferFrom; it carries no independent semantics
_value is the amount argument driving every mutation inside transferFrom and should be folded into that function
_tos is only the recipient array iterated by batchSend and has no standalone role
the local total exists solely as the unchecked multiplication result, so it merges into that unsafe arithmetic operation
parameter a is only meaningful as the target of a.delegatecall(b) and therefore belongs to the unsafe delegatecall operation
_UNI is a transient local computed within ensure() to widen its whitelist and must be merged into that function
